cold_open: Eric and Jeff are 2–2 and meet for the fifth time. Brian Clark is one game behind Evan in their series, and one behind Kevin Swanson in the all-time wins race, 194–193. Clark plays Evan this week; Swanson plays Fadi.

notes.Dominic|Steve Swanson: Dominic beat Steve for the 2008 title and leads the series 16–13. Steve has won three of the last five, including this same week a year ago: 104.98–82.58 in Week 5.
notes.Douglas|Shawn: Shawn leads 8–6 and once won four straight, 2019 to 2022. Doug has taken three of the last five, and the last one was ugly: 89.45–36.24, a 53.21-point beating.
notes.Kevin O'Boyle|Thomas: Tom has won five straight, matching his 2013–15 run as the longest in the series; one more sets the record. O'Boyle owns the biggest blowout, 70.08 points in 2017. Tom leads 17–14.
notes.Eric|Jeff: Four meetings, 2–2, and this one breaks the tie. Jeff won their closest, by 1.88 points in Week 5 of 2024 — also their highest-scoring game. Eric won the last, 86.7–63.16.
notes.Brian Clark|Evan: Evan once led this series by six; it's down to 15–14. Clark has won four of the last five, the last 73.6–70.48, and took their closest game by 0.53 in 2023. One more evens it.
notes.Fadi|Kevin Swanson: Swanson leads 17–14 and has won four of the last five. Fadi took the most recent, 88.72–54.07 last year, and owns the series' biggest blowout: 82.45 points in 2008.

milestone.label: Steve Swanson · Points to 22,500
milestone.text: Steve Swanson is 60.88 points from 22,500 for his career; Kevin O'Boyle is 121.55 from 27,500. In the all-time wins race, Kevin Swanson leads Brian Clark 194–193.

kicker: For the second straight week, all six games cross division lines.
